email.body1:
Mike, saw Simpro launched Lightning, your AI-native platform, across Simpro, AroFlo and BigChange.

When three brands ramp a new platform at once, the gap between a signal firing and a rep acting on it widens, and in-market accounts go cold first. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, sequenced outreach on its own, so signal-to-action latency drops without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Simpro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Simpro.

Most global RevOps teams know there's lift left in outbound, but the signal-to-meeting handoff across brands is where measurable revenue leaks. Our built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound motion, three things I'd change, and where data hygiene and timing gaps are costing Simpro meetings.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Simpro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Simpro's reply rate likely compares to other field-service software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount isn't a priority while you ramp Lightning, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and a multi-brand launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your global RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Simpro either way.
